description: Search localized Zendesk Help Center articles by text and filters.

inputSchema.description: Request parameters for searching Zendesk Help Center articles.

brand_id.description: Brand ID to search, as a string.
brand_id.title: Brand Id

category.description: One or more comma-separated category IDs.
category.title: Category

label_names.description: Comma-separated article labels. An article matching any label is returned.
label_names.title: Label Names

locale.description: Enabled locale to search, such as 'en-us', or '*' for every locale.
locale.title: Locale

multibrand.description: Search all brands when true and brand_id is omitted.
multibrand.title: Multibrand

per_page.description: Number of results to return per page, from 1 to 100.
per_page.title: Per Page

query.description: Text to match in Help Center articles.
query.title: Query

section.description: One or more comma-separated section IDs.
section.title: Section

sort_by.description: Sort by creation or update time. Omit to sort by relevance.
sort_by.title: Sort By

sort_order.description: Sort direction. Zendesk defaults to descending when a sort field is used.
sort_order.title: Sort Order

inputSchema.title: SearchHelpCenterArticlesRequest

name: search_help_center_articles

HelpCenterArticleSearchResult.description: A Help Center article returned by Zendesk search.

draft.description: Whether the article is a draft.
draft.title: Draft

html_url.description: Public Help Center URL for the article.
html_url.title: Html Url

permission_group_id.description: Permission group allowed to manage the article.
permission_group_id.title: Permission Group Id

promoted.description: Whether the article is promoted in Help Center.
promoted.title: Promoted

result_type.description: Search result type, which is 'article' for this endpoint.
result_type.title: Result Type

snippet.description: Article excerpt relevant to the search query.
snippet.title: Snippet

user_segment_id.description: User segment allowed to view the article.
user_segment_id.title: User Segment Id

HelpCenterArticleSearchResult.title: HelpCenterArticleSearchResult

SearchHelpCenterArticlesResponse.description: One page of Help Center article search results.

next_page.description: URL for the next page, if any.
next_page.title: Next Page

previous_page.description: URL for the previous page, if any.
previous_page.title: Previous Page

SearchHelpCenterArticlesResponse.title: SearchHelpCenterArticlesResponse
